'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*Around 200 anti-government militants block a road in [[Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region|Gorno-Badakhshan]], [[Tajikistan]], which links the country to [[China]]. Some of the militants, armed with firearms and petrol bombs, later ambush a security convoy on the same road. Eight militants and one officer are killed, while 13 officers are injured and more than 70 militants are arrested. The Tajik interior ministry later say the attack was an attempt to "destabilise the social and political situation" in the region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/tajikistan-starts-anti-terror-operation-near-china-afghan-borders-ria-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)] 

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 global supply chain crisis]]
**[[2022 United States infant formula shortage]]
***The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] votes to pass a series of legislation aimed at combating the [[baby formula]] shortage in the [[United States]]. The Access to Baby Formula Act passes with a 414–9 vote, and the Infant Formula Supplemental Appropriations Act passes with a 231–192. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/amp/rcna29497 (NBC News)] [https://www.newsweek.com/full-list-house-republicans-voted-against-fda-baby-formula-bill-1708036?amp=1 (Newsweek)]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] invokes the [[Defense Production Act of 1950|Defense Production Act]] to solve the baby formula shortage in the U.S. [https://www.cnbc.com/amp/2022/05/18/biden-invokes-defense-production-act-to-address-infant-formula-shortage.html (CNBC)]
*[[Google]]'s Russian [[subsidiary]] announces its intention to file for [[bankruptcy]] after [[Russia]]n authorities seize the company's bank account. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/googles-russian-subsidiary-files-bankruptcy-document-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Twelve people are killed and another is injured after a wall of a salt factory collapses in [[Morbi]], [[Gujarat]], [[India]]. Several others are missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/twelve-workers-killed-by-wall-collapse-india-salt-factory-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and several others are injured after a car drives into 14 cyclists in [[Przypki]], [[Poland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/poland-warsaw-fadb95227639628f6593b589c3ab7405 (AP)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Portugal]] confirms its first five cases of [[monkeypox]]. [https://apnews.com/article/health-africa-spain-portugal-db38eb683180531f0589c347bfc85358 (AP)]
**[[Spain]] says that it is monitoring eight potential monkeypox cases. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/portugal-identifies-five-monkeypox-infections-spain-has-eight-suspected-cases-1.5908927 (CTV News)]
**The [[United States]] confirms its first case of monkeypox in 2022, in a man from [[Massachusetts]] who recently traveled to [[Canada]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/massachusetts-man-tests-positive-monkeypox/story?id=84817514&cid=social_twitter_abcn (ABC News)]
*[[Mozambique]] confirms its first [[polio]] case in 30 years in the northwestern [[provinces of Mozambique|province]] of [[Tete Province|Tete]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/mozambique-detects-first-case-polio-30-years-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Government and intergovernmental reactions to the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine–United States relations]]
***The [[Embassy of the United States, Kyiv|American embassy]] in [[Kyiv]] reopens for the first time since the beginning of the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion]] of [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/us-reopens-kyiv-embassy-after-three-month-closure-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[France–Russia relations]], [[Italy–Russia relations]], [[Russia–Spain relations]]
**The [[Russian Foreign Ministry]] expels 85 [[diplomat]]s from [[France]], [[Spain]], and [[Italy]] in response to the expulsions of Russian diplomats from [[European Union]] nations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-expels-85-diplomats-france-spain-italy-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Enlargement of NATO]]
**[[Finland]] and [[Sweden]] both formally apply to join [[NATO]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/finland-sweden-submit-application-join-nato-2022-05-18/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three people are killed and five others injured after a man [[mass shooting|opens fire]] at his former [[workplace shooting|workplace]] in [[Ilam province]], [[Iran]], before [[Murder–suicide|committing suicide]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-iran-shootings-6c6d0682729a4fe21c59e07b3da9bd40 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[30th Alberta Legislature]]
**[[Premier of Alberta]] [[Jason Kenney]] announces his intention to resign as leader of the [[United Conservative Party]] after a [[leadership review]] results in 51.4% approval of his leadership from party members. He will be replaced as leader and premier once a successor is named. [https://apnews.com/article/politics-canada-alberta-calgary-jason-kenney-3a18da3a385f3b1bb8d4f6b616662681 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2021–22 UEFA Europa League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Eintracht Frankfurt]] defeat the [[Rangers F.C.|Glasgow Rangers]] 5–4 on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] to win the [[UEFA Europa League]] following a 1–1 draw after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] in the [[2022 UEFA Europa League Final|final]] at the [[Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Stadium]] in [[Seville]], Spain. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/05/18/football/rangers-eintracht-frankfurt-europa-league-final-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
